result:
Task complete. Summary:

**Found the real data**: `sap_mapping.sqlite` isn't in this git repo — it lives at `/opt/veridian/ai-os/memory/sap_mapping.sqlite`, shared non-git infra state. It has **80** rows across 11 SAP modules (spec said 87; ingest_log shows all modules `DONE`, so 80 is the real, complete count — I proceeded with actual data rather than fabricating 7 extra rows).

**Classification**: Added `engine_track TEXT` column, read every row's real `calculation_logic` text, and classified based on whether the report is a pure deterministic formula/read (`calculation`), centers on a persisted state machine/status pipeline with little real formula (`workflow` — e.g. SAP order system-status, document-flow tracing, bank-statement match queues), or applies real formulas on top of live stage/SLA state (`hybrid` — e.g. CRM weighted pipeline value, AR dunning-level escalation, AP approval-status payment-due).

**Result**: 67 calculation / 9 hybrid / 4 workflow, verified with 0 NULL rows.

Took a pre-change backup of the sqlite file (that directory has a history of corruption from concurrent writes), registered/closed the work in `ai-os/boss/ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml` per protocol, and opened PR [#624](https://github.com/FChecklist/compliance-tracker/pull/624) for the repo-tracked bookkeeping (PROGRESS.md + ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml) — the sqlite mutation itself is outside git so there's nothing else to PR.
